description: This file implements a Service Worker for a trace viewer application, handling trace loading, resource serving, and cache management.

classes.name: SnapshotServer
classes.description: Handles serving snapshot and resource data for traces.

classes.name: TraceModel
classes.description: Represents the trace data model loaded from trace files.

classes.name: TraceViewerServer
classes.description: Provides server functionalities for trace viewing, such as reading files.

methods.name: loadTrace
methods.description: Loads a trace from a URL, handling different formats and errors, and initializes associated snapshot server.

methods.name: doFetch
methods.description: Handles fetch events, serving trace data, snapshots, and static assets based on request URL.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection of cached traces and trace URLs based on client activity.
